noticias.titulo: Snowflake CMO NYSE Setting is 'Huge Inspiration' for Startup Campaign Finalists
noticias.descripcion: In this NYSE Live interview, Denise Persson, Chief Marketing Officer at Snowflake, discusses how artificial intelligence, trusted data, and enterprise innovation are reshaping business operations and modern marketing. Persson begins by reflecting on Snowflake's Startup Challenge and the significance of bringing innovative early-stage companies to the New York Stock Exchange. She describes the NYSE as an inspiring environment for entrepreneurs and founders working toward ambitious long-term goals. A significant portion of the discussion focuses on the common characteristics shared by this year's finalists. According to Persson, the participating startups are leveraging data and AI to solve unique business challenges while building on the Snowflake platform's data infrastructure and analytics capabilities. The interview also explores the importance of data governance. Persson argues that AI systems are only as trustworthy as the data they are built upon, making governance, quality, transparency, and security foundational requirements for achieving reliable business outcomes. Another major theme is the impact of AI on marketing organizations. Persson explains that marketers are gaining new capabilities around personalization, audience engagement, workflow automation, and customer experience optimization. At the same time, organizations must navigate increasingly complex data ecosystems while ensuring responsible AI implementation. The conversation further examines Snowflake's own AI adoption strategy. The company's marketing team has progressed from experimentation to broad adoption and is now focusing on transformational use cases that drive measurable business value while improving operational efficiency. The interview also highlights how AI is helping creative and marketing teams automate production-intensive tasks. Automating repetitive work allows employees to dedicate more time to strategy, creativity, customer engagement, and innovation. Trust remains another key area of discussion. Persson believes organizations must be transparent about how customer data is used and protected, particularly as AI-powered personalization becomes more prevalent. Strong governance and ethical data practices will play a central role in earning and maintaining consumer trust. Additionally, the conversation explores what remains uniquely human in an AI-powered future. Persson points to creativity, judgment, strategic thinking, customer empathy, and trust-building as areas where human expertise will remain essential even as automation capabilities continue to advance. Looking ahead, Persson expects AI to become an increasingly powerful tool for helping organizations improve decision-making, streamline operations, and create more meaningful customer experiences while empowering employees to focus on higher-order work. Throughout the discussion, Persson shares perspectives on artificial intelligence, data governance, enterprise technology, marketing transformation, customer trust, startup innovation, business intelligence, digital strategy, and the future of AI-powered organizations. Disclaimer: Informational content only. NYSE does not endorse or recommend investments, strategies, companies, products, or services discussed.

Software IA.titulo: Snowflake CMO NYSE Setting is 'Huge Inspiration' for Startup Campaign Finalists
Software IA.descripcion: In this NYSE Live interview, Denise Persson, Chief Marketing Officer at Snowflake, discusses how artificial intelligence, trusted data, and enterprise innovation are reshaping business operations and modern marketing. Persson begins by reflecting on Snowflake's Startup Challenge and the significance of bringing innovative early-stage companies to the New York Stock Exchange. She describes the NYSE as an inspiring environment for entrepreneurs and founders working toward ambitious long-term goals. A significant portion of the discussion focuses on the common characteristics shared by this year's finalists. According to Persson, the participating startups are leveraging data and AI to solve unique business challenges while building on the Snowflake platform's data infrastructure and analytics capabilities. The interview also explores the importance of data governance. Persson argues that AI systems are only as trustworthy as the data they are built upon, making governance, quality, transparency, and security foundational requirements for achieving reliable business outcomes. Another major theme is the impact of AI on marketing organizations. Persson explains that marketers are gaining new capabilities around personalization, audience engagement, workflow automation, and customer experience optimization. At the same time, organizations must navigate increasingly complex data ecosystems while ensuring responsible AI implementation. The conversation further examines Snowflake's own AI adoption strategy. The company's marketing team has progressed from experimentation to broad adoption and is now focusing on transformational use cases that drive measurable business value while improving operational efficiency. The interview also highlights how AI is helping creative and marketing teams automate production-intensive tasks. Automating repetitive work allows employees to dedicate more time to strategy, creativity, customer engagement, and innovation. Trust remains another key area of discussion. Persson believes organizations must be transparent about how customer data is used and protected, particularly as AI-powered personalization becomes more prevalent. Strong governance and ethical data practices will play a central role in earning and maintaining consumer trust. Additionally, the conversation explores what remains uniquely human in an AI-powered future. Persson points to creativity, judgment, strategic thinking, customer empathy, and trust-building as areas where human expertise will remain essential even as automation capabilities continue to advance. Looking ahead, Persson expects AI to become an increasingly powerful tool for helping organizations improve decision-making, streamline operations, and create more meaningful customer experiences while empowering employees to focus on higher-order work. Throughout the discussion, Persson shares perspectives on artificial intelligence, data governance, enterprise technology, marketing transformation, customer trust, startup innovation, business intelligence, digital strategy, and the future of AI-powered organizations.
